Comment your guess before you watch 👇

Class 11 Physics · Laws of Motion (Friction)
Physics, visualised #4

Gravity pulls the block down the slope with mg sin θ. Friction can hold it back with at most μ mg cos θ. As the ramp tilts, the pull grows and friction's limit shrinks. The moment the pull wins, it slips:
mg sin θ = μ mg cos θ → tan θ = μ.
Here μ = 0.7, so it slips at 35° → B.
